tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgyu 'phrul las sgrub ces bya ba

bzhugs so// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgyu 'phrul las sgrub ces bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos gang gdod nas sgyu ma bzhin// sgrub pa med las der snang ba'i// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i las rab 'byams// sgrub mdzad snying rje'i stobs der 'dud// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas shing bsnyen pa thems pa'i sngags pas/ rang gzhan gyi don gang yang rung ba bsgrub pa ni/ ji skad du/ sdig pa sreg cing bgegs rnams zhi bya dang*// sngags kyi gzi bskyed lha rnams mnyes bya'i phyir// bzlas dang sgom pa'i thog mtha' thams cad du// sngags pas sbyin sreg cho ga gzhung bzhin bya// zhes gsungs pa 'di nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sbyor ba thab rdzas 'du bya ba/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed nas mchod sbyin bya ba/ rjes su bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po sbyor ba thab rdzas 'du bya ba ni/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'am/ ma 'brel na phyogs can gyi shar du zhi ba/ lho ru rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ yang na/ zhi dbang shar/ dgug pa nub/ drag po byang*/ rgyas pa lhor bya/ de rnams gang la'ang skabs su bab pa'i sa chog rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tsham pa byas la stegs bu bya'o// de yang thab rko rtsig 'bri gsum las/ brko ba ni/ thab kyi dpangs tshad dang mnyam pa'i stegs bu brtsigs la de'i dbus nas thur du bru/ brtsig pa ni/ stegs bu dpangs sor bzhi tsam byas pa'i steng du brtsig /bri na yang stegs bu phyi ma nyid kyi steng du brtsig /de la brko ba'am brtsig na/ zhi ba'i thab sa gzhi dkar po'i steng du rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su de'i phyed/ nang du rgyar sor brgyad/ dpangs su sor bzhi pa'i pad 'dab kyi lte bar nyi ma la gtso bo'i mtshan ma thob la/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar lha mo bzhi'i mtshan ma dkyil chog du bshad pa ltar mtshams bzhir thod pa/

padma'i phyir rdo rje'i phreng ba/ thab kyi phyir mchu sor bzhi dor bar kha khyer sor bzhi rgya dpangs mnyam pa sor bzhi par rdo rje'i phreng ba/ de'i phyir gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse gsum pa bkod la/ dri dkar po dang sa dkar po byugs/ me tog dkar po gcal du bkram mo// rgyas pa'i thab rgyar khru do zabs su khru gang*/ mchu dang kha khyer dang nang gi padma dang lha mtshan sogs kyang zhi ba nyis 'gyur gyi tshad/ kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba dang grwa bzhir zla phyed rin po che/ dri dang tshon dang me tog ser po gzhan sngar ltar/ dbang gi thab gru gsum zhes pa zla kham lta bu rgyar sor nyi shu dpangs su de'i phyed/ sor gsum pa'i mchu dang kha khyer can/ kha khyer la padma'i phreng ba/ grwa bzhir padma dang dri dang me tog dmar po gzhan sngar ltar/ dbang gi dgug pa'i thab kyang dbang thab ltar la/ kha khyer grwa bzhir lcags kyu/ drag po la dbyibs gru gsum tshad dbang thab lta bu kha khyer dang grwa la gri gug bris la/ de'ang sa phyogs gnag cing snying po ma yin pa dang*/ gas pa dang*/ tsha sgo can du bya/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs dang dri nga ba byugs/ me tog nag po dang sngon po bkram/ bris thab ni rgya tshad snga ma lta bu man ngag ltar thig btab la las mthun gyi tshon gyis bri'o// dgang blugs kyi tshad 'dir ma smos te sngar grub zin ma gtogs deng gsar bcos nyung bas so// yam shing zhi ba la 'o ma can gyi shing rtse mo'i cha las byung ba mtho gang*/ sboms mthe'u chung tsam la rlan dang lo mar bcas pa mar sbrang 'o mas rtse mo sbags pa/ dri dkar pos byugs pa/ de'ang lo ma gnyis pa rtse mo gcig pa zung re mthe bong dang srin lag gis bsreg go// rgyas pa'i yam shing rgyu de dang 'dra ba dbus kyi cha las byung ba khru gang*/ sboms 'chang gang dri ser pos byugs shing sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ dbang gi yam shing dri zhim la me tog dang 'bras bu dmar po ste/

skyur ba'i shing las sor lnga pa me tog dmar po bcings pa dmar pos sbags pa/ dgug par yang tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu can gyi shing la tshad sogs dbang dang 'dra/ drag po la nim pa dang*/ seng ldeng dang*/ dur khrod kyi shing la sogs pa/ ro kha ba tsher ma can la byas pa sor bcu pa/ rtse mo gnyis rnon por gzhogs pa khrag dang yungs mar gyis sbags pa lta bu'o// zhi ba'i bud shing mchod sbyin gyi shing ngam/ nags kyi ba lang gi lci ba srog chags med pa thab khung las cung zad dma' bar brtsig /rgyas pa'i bud shing ba lang gi lci ba ma gtogs par 'bras bu can gyi shing la bya/ dbang la shing ro skyur ba me tog dmar po can/ dgug pa la tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa/ drag po la shing kha ba dang*/ tsha ba dang*/ tsher ma can dang*/ dur khrod kyi shing dang*/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i rtug pa sogs so// mar khu ni zhi rgyas dbang dgug la mar dkar dris sbags pa dang*/ drag po la mar nag dang zhun chen sogs so// zhi ba'i sreg rdzas khyad par ba ni/ mar dang*/ til dkar po dang*/ zas mchog dang*/ ku sha gsar pa dang*/ dūrba dang*/ tsandan dkar po dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ zho dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ me tog dkar po rnams ci 'byor ba/ rgyas pa'i khyad par ba ni/ zhi ba dang 'dra la 'bras sa lu dang me tog ser po la sogs pa'o// dbang dgug gi khyad par ba ni/ zhi ba ltar la kha dog dmar po can bya'o// drag po'i khyad par ba ni/ mar nag dang*/ til nag /yungs nag /ske tshe/ lan tshwa/ nim pa'i 'dab ma/ dur khrod kyi thal ba/ dgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs rnams ci rnyed pa'am thams cad kyang rung ste/ dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ lan tshwa dang sbyar ba la dgra gzugs byas par dgug dbye mang du byas te gtub cing bsreg go// zhi ba'i las ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra bya/ dri zhim pos byugs/ gos rgyan dkar po bya/ kha nub tu bltas la stan nang tshangs can la sems skyil gyis 'dug cing*/

byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyis yar ngo'i tshes gcig gi tho rangs nas brtsams te bya'o// rgyas pa'i las ni| gos rgyan ser po/ stan khra bo sogs la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis dga' zhing byams pa'i sems kyis kha byang du bltas la nya'i nyin mo snga dro nas brtsams la bya'o// dbang gi las ni/ rgyan gos dmar po stan mthon po la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis chags shing zhen pa'i sems kyis kha shar du bltas la phyi dro'i dus bya'o// dgug pa yang dbang dang 'dra la khyad par ni kha byang du bltas la bya'o// drag po'i las ni/ gos rgyan sngon po'am nag po khrag dang chus sbangs pa bgos la/ stan sra ba'am bsgrub bya'i gzugs kyi snying gar 'dug pa'am/ stan med par bsgrub bya sdig pa las bzlog pa'i phyir khro zhing gdug pa'i sems kyis g.yon brkyang gis nyin phyed dam/ mtshan phyed na hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lcags kyus bsgrub bya'i bsrung ba bcad la bya'o// arghaṃ sogs kyi snod zhi ba la/ dngul lam/ dung dang*/ nya phyis la sogs par nas dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ dri dkar po dang ldan pa'i chu blugs par gtso bo'i sngags mthar swā hā btags pa lan bdun sngags pa'o// rgyas pa la/ gser la sogs pa'i snod du dri ser po'i chu la til dang*/ zho blugs par gtso bo'i sngags la oṃ btags pa bzlas pa'o// dbang dang dgug pa la/ zangs la sogs pa'i snod du dri dmar po'i chu la sngags mthar hoḥbatags pa bzlas so// drag po la/ lcags dang*/ mi thod la sogs par dri mi zhim pa gnag pa dang bcas pa'i gcin la sogs par sngags mthar mā ra ya phaṭa btags pa bzla'o// bsham tshul ni zhi rgyas dbang dang de'i dgug pa la ni sreg rdzas rnams rang gi g.yas dang*/ chu gsum gyi snod bzed zhal dang bcas pa rang gi g.yon du las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi steng du bshams/ drag po la ni de las go log par bsham mo// rang gi mdun du mar khu/

dgang blugs/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ gtor ma dang gos zung las mthun gyi kha dog can gnyis gnyis/ nyer spyod ku sha'i chun po rlung g.yab la sogs pa nyer mkho rnams bshams/ gzhan yang las bzhi ga thun mong ba'i sreg rdzas/ til/ yungs dkar/ zas mchog /ku sha/ dūrba/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma/ so ba/ shing thog sna tshogs pa rnams sa rdo phub ma med cing 'bras ni ma grug pa/ so ba ni shun pa dang ma bral ba rnams kyang g.yas su bshams/ sreg rdzas kun gyi mgor yam shing bzhag go// me ni zhi ba la shing 'o ma can gtsubs pa las byung ba'am/ bram ze'i sbyin sreg gi me/ rgyas pa la dge 'dun gyi bsro khang gi me'am/ rgyal rigs dang rje rigs kyi khyim gyi me/ dbang la rje rigs dang smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi me/ dgug pa la gar mkhan dang sprang po dang lam du bus pa'i me/ drag po la dur khrod kyi shing dang rdo gtsubs pa'am/ shan pa'i khyim gyi mes bya'o// de ltar mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas thams cad la/ las sngags dang hūm̐ lan gsum bzlas pa'i chus bsangs/ gu gul gyis bdug /sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas sbags par bya'o// bsang chu ni/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na las bum gyi chus bya zhing skabs gzhan du chu gtsang las mthun gyi dris sbags par las thams cad pa dang hūm̐ brgya phrag sogs bzlas pa kho nas rung ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha bskyed nas mchod sbyin bya ba ni/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na skabs 'dir bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas/ ma hā badzra hūm̐ gis lag g.yas rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon pas dril bu gsil zhing dku g.yon du bzung*/ mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ khyad par ni zhal bsil gyi rjes su zhabs bsil bcug go// 'jam gsum la lag pa g.yas dang*/ drag po la g.yon pas bsang chu rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/

spro na/ oṃ ma hā swā hā sogs sngags tshig lngas rdzas bkru sbyang bya'o// mi spro na 'di rgya gzhung na med pas mi dgos/ sreg rdzas rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ las thams cad pas me bsangs nas sbar ba ku sha dang dpal 'bar lhan cig la sbar ba las sngags kyis bsangs thab du bcug /oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzla zhing rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ spro na ku sha 'di ni sogs tshigs bcad dang mi spro na rgya gzhung du med pas/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes bzlas pas ku sha rlon pa shin tu ring ba ma yin pa thog mar rtse mo shar du bstan la/ 'jam gsum la g.yas skor/ drag po la g.yon skor du thab kyi phyi rol du bkram zhing brtsigs/ ba lang gi rna ba lta bu thab steng du g.yogs/ thab dang me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las mthun gyi kha dog can yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa/ dbang dang dgug pa'i thab khung dmar po gru gsum pa'i dbyibs can zla kham/ drag po'i thab khung nag po zur gsum pa ces so so la/ de rnams thun mong du/ rgya'i phyed kyi zabs dang ldan zhing*/ mchu dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la las mthun gyi mtshan ma'i phreng ba can mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma dang ra las nyi ma'i gdan la raṃ las/ zhi ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar po zhi zhing byams pa'i nyams can/ rgyas pa'i me lha sku mdog ser po tshim zhing rangs pa'i nyams can/ dbang dang dgug pa'i me lha sku mdog dmar po brtse zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ drag po'i me lha sku mdog nag po khro gtum 'khrug pa'i nyams can/ zhes las so sor sbyar zhing*/ thun mong du/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blug 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang zhing*/

gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog can gyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad dkris pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur par bskyed/ rdor dril 'dzin pas g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i rgya las mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yob cing*| oṃ agna ye ma hā te dza sarba karma pra sa kā ru ṇa kṛ twa santa artha asmiṃ sanni hi to bha wa/ zhes bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i lha ye shes pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ hūm̐ zhes phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi me lha la dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya zhing*/ mnyes par byas pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa lā ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ shya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dam la bzhag /oṃ āḥhrīḥpra ba ra satkā raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ bcug pa'i chu gsum dbul/ me lha'i dpral bar tsi ser po sogs/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur gyi bar go cha drug dang*/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lhas bum pa bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag |chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ zhal bsil/ zhabs bkru/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/

rol mos mchod/ nang mchod thigs gtor dbul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ 'jam gsum la/ me lha zhal cung zad gdangs pa dang*/ drag po la/ zhal shin tu gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje las mthun gyi kha dog can dang dgang blugs kyi khar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par bsam/ dgang blugs mar gyis gang ba kha steng nas steng du brtsigs pa bzung la/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs kha sbyar 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor du gru mo gnyis pus mo'i phyir mi 'da' bas lan bdun dbul/ dgang blugs ni/ zhi ba la rdo rje'i khu tshur/ rgyas pa la rin po che'i khu tshur/ dbang la padma'i khu tshur/ drag po la khro bo'i khu tshur gyis bzung*/ skabs 'dir me pra brtag te/ me'i kha dog spyir 'ja' tshon lta bu/ bye brag zhi la dkar/ rgyas la ser/ dbang dgug dmar/ drag po la gnag /de yang rtse mo shin tu 'bar ba dri med cing sgra zab pa sogs bzang*/ du ba che zhing me stag 'phro ba/ dal bus 'bar ba/ zhan pa/ me lce chad pa/ 'od med cing sngo ba/ mdung rtse gsum dang*/ zhi ba la rnga mo dang ba lang gi gdong g-i dbyibs lta bu dang*/ mi ro'i dri dang*/ dri med pa dang ches drag du 'bar ba sogs ngan/ de ltar ngan pa bgegs yod pa'i mtshan ma mthong na las thams cad pas bsang gtor bya/ gtso bo'i sngags kyis bsrung*/ gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun nam gsum dang*/ las sngags kyis dgang blugs gsum dbul/ bzang na de dag mi dgos/ de nas/ oṃ agna ye zhes pa la/ yaṃ shing nas shing thog gi bar so so'i sngags 'og nas 'byung ba ltar spyi sgos kyi spel tshig dang bcas pas ci rigs dbul/ de nas/ bsang gtor bya zhing*/ oṃ agna ye prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ 'thor 'thung 'bul/ oṃ/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog

/'byung po yongs la bskyab bya'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rig pa grub pa drang srong tshul// nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan spyi blugs dang*// bgrang phreng dag ni 'dzin par mdzad// de bas bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces bstod cing*/ me lha 'khor dang bcas pas rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon 'jigs pa chen po thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol| khyad par du'ang gang 'dod pa'i phrin las chen mo da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol/ me lha me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur// me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje'i ra gur 'jigs dus kyi me ltar 'bar zhing*/ me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad rang rang gi bkod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas bskor ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūṃ las mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa 'od 'phro ba mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re gsal pa'i gdan dbus ma dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gdan la thog mtha' med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thig le mu tig gi mdog ltar 'tsher zhing 'od 'bar ba rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su hrīḥ'am hūm̐ nag po dang oṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma shar du hūm̐ dkar po/ lhor swā ser po/ nub tu hrīḥdamar po/ byang du hā ljang gu rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi/

phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa'i bar gyis yab yum dang*/ 'dab ma shar du mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa nas/ me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i bar gyis lha mo bzhi dang bcas pa bskyed la/ khyad par ni/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku dang rtsa zhal las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can zhal lhag ma zhes bsgyur/ yab kyi nu ma'i bar du hūm̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥhūm̐ nag po 'bar ba las rdo rje'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la bstim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar tsi ser po zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgom/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yod na de dag nas lha rnams me tog gi tshom bus spyan drangs/ thab tu so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de nas lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can dgang blugs kyi khar hūm̐ yig re res mtshan pa| lha rnams 'jam gsum la/ zhal cung zad gdangs pa dang*/ drag po la shin tu gdangs par gyur par mos nas/ thog mar me lha'i sngags kho nas dgang blugs nyer gcig gtso bo la/ yum lnga la bdun dbul/ de rjes/ gtso bo'i sngags la/ oṃ badzra yadzñā ya swā hā/ btags pas yam shing zung du sbyar ba brgya rtsa sogs phul mthar/ bdag gi gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa dang khyad par che ge mo shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes zhi ba la'o// rgyas pa la/ phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang khyad par che ge mo puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang khyad par che ge mo wa shyaṃ ku ru hoḥ dgug pa la/ phun sum tshogs pa dang khyad par che ge mo ā karṣa ya dzaḥhrīṃḥ drag po la/ phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa rnams dang khyad par che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces sbyar/

de bzhin du/ mar khu la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ 'byor pa= til la/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ sdig pa dang bral ba= yungs dkar la/ oṃ sarba artha sā dha ya swā hā/ bgegs kyi gnyen po= zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ 'byor ba= ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ srung ba= dūrba la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe= nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ lus kyi shugs= gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma re swā hā| nad med pa= sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ lus kyi stobs= so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ye swā hā/ bde legs= shing thog sna tshogs la/ oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni bi lo ki te swā hā/ rigs brgyud= zhes dang*/ las so so'i khyad par gyi rdzas rnams dang*/ bla med la sha sna tshogs 'bul bar gsungs pa sogs kyang gtso bo'i sngags nyid kyis dbul/ sbyin sreg rgya gzhung du/ mar/ yam shing*/ til/ 'bras bu sna tshogs/ dūrba| ku sha/ zan rnams las ma gsungs kyang rdzas gzhan rnams 'bul du mi rung ba ma yin pas/ de bzhin du lha mo lnga lha so so'i sngags mthar rdzas sngags spel tshig btags pas dbul/ de yang gtso bo la brgya rtsa sogs gang lcogs/ lha mo lnga la nyer gcig sogs gang grub dbul/ de nas/ srab 'jam yang sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra wast+ra ye swā hās gos bzung dbul/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs bshad pa ltar phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ sgyu 'phrul chen po 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar gyis dbul/ thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā yā lha lnga'i bdag nyid can// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi sngon gyi las dang zhes sogs/ me lha'i skabs ltar 'dod don gsol/

ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra muḥ sgyu 'phrul chen po lha lnga'i ye shes pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur par mos/ rdul tshon sa spyan drangs na slar yang thab khung nas sa me tog dang bcas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nyid du spyan drangs so// gsum pa ni rjes su bya ba'i rim pa ni/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs gcig phul nas| me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam pa las/ slar me lha sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur par bsam/ sngags des dgang blugs bdun du dbul/ slar yam shing nas shing thog gi bar me lha'i sngags la rdzas sngags spel tshig sbyar la lan gsum res gtang rag tu 'bul/ srab 'jam yang ba lha'i gos sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra wa sa sya pra tītstsha swā hā/ gos zung 'bul/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/ snod gsar pa gas chag med pa'i nang du rdzas lhag ma rnams 'o mar sbyar ba'i 'o thug gi tsā ru me de nyid kyis bsgrubs la/ phud dkyil 'khor la dbul/ lhag ma dngos grub kyi ched du longs spyad/ chu gsum nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭa kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad bskangs/ sngar ltar bzod par gsol nas/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don rnams ni// bsgrubs te sbyin sreg gsol la bzhud// slar yang dus bzhin gshegs nas su// bdag gi sngags kyi dngos grub mdzod// oṃ badzra muḥ

me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam mo// shis brjod bsngo smon bya'o// long yod na me rang zhir btang*/ med na 'jam gsum la 'o ma dang dri bzang bsres pa'i chu dang*/ drag po la dug gis me gzhil/ thal sol ni/ zhi ba'i thal sol chur sbyang*/ rgyas pa'i thal sol bang mdzod du sba/ dbang gi thal sol ri mthon po'i rlung la 'phyar/ drag po'i thal sol lha 'dre gnas sar rlung la 'phyar ram lam rgya gram du mnan/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar yang 'das lha'i rdzas 'bul ba la rdzas thams cad grangs gcig du nges pa kho na ma zad/ yam shing dang mar ni kun la dgos shing*/ gzhan las gang sgrub la dpags te/ sdig pa zhi ba gtso bor byed na til kho nas sgrub pa sogs kyang skabs thob dang sbyor/ las thams cad ni rgya gzhung 'dir ma gsungs pas ma bkod/ dam bzhag dang gtor ma gos zung sogs kyang rgya gzhung du ma gsungs kyang rung bar sems pas bris pa yin no// smras pa/ gtum po'i 'od kyi snang ba 'bum 'gyed pa'i// rmad byung thabs kyi zhi sogs las rab 'byams// gang bsam 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpag bsam ni// 'di zhes rdo rje 'chang gis lan brgyar gsungs// des na 'dod lha mchod sbyin gyis tshims nas// rang 'dod gegs med bsgrub 'di nyams su longs// de ltar sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgyu 'phrul las sgrub ces bya ba 'di'ang*/ grub chen ku ku ri pas mdzad pa gtsor bzhag gis legs bshad gzhan khungs thub nas kyang cung zad bskangs te/ rgyud don la lta ba'i mig dang ldan pa dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ sa skyong gi lo chu stod zla ba snga ma'i dkar po'i stong pa dang por dbur stod bkra shis tshugs kyi pho brang ba gam gsum pa'i re'u mig padma 'od du sbyar bas sems can kun la sman pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
